secrets.description: GitHub App ID for the bot account that owns app repos. Without this, app creation fails and no PRs can be opened.
PEM private key for the GitHub App. Single-line with literal \n escape sequences; the loader un-escapes at startup.
Classic PAT with `repo` scope for the bot user. Powers repo creation, branch pushes, PR creation, and the in-app feedback flow (Issues:write on USERNODE_PLATFORM_REPO).
Platform-wide fallback Claude key. Users can override with their own via BYOK; if neither is set, Mayor-driven flows are unavailable.
Bootstrap admin username. The first row in `users` is created with this name and is_admin=true on first boot.
Bootstrap admin password. Hashed at first boot — rotating only takes effect on a fresh DB or via direct SQL update.
